observedRecipe.name: Shawrma Rice Mexican
missing_ingredients: 1 portion for the tahini dressing 1 4 cup tahini
steps: Prepare the tahini dressing: In a small bowl, whisk together tahini, lemon juice, minced garlic, and salt. Gradually whisk in water until the dressing reaches your desired consistency.
Assemble the bowls: Divide the cooked rice among serving bowls. Top with chopped lettuce, tomatoes, cucumber, red onion, and sliced shawrma.
Drizzle generously with the tahini dressing.
